name: Smithing
notes_prerequisites: No prerequisites is left as [], if the skill has another skill prerequisite then that skill must be known before this skill can be gained/learned
notes_item_creation: Can craft material, these are cumulative, at lvl 4 the smith can use Meteoric, steel, iron, bronze... At 5 all materials in the game can be used.
notes_repair: Repair effectiveness is the maximum condition percentage the smith can achieve when repairing items. For example, a Novice Smith can repair items up to 70% condition, while a Grandmaster Smith can repair items to full condition (100%). Players with no smithing skill can still repair up to 25% (condition: 25)
